axis_fit: Upright bottle: height >=80px, width >=20px, aspect 2.5..6; stable narrow upper profile and broad body support. Expand horizontal bbox around median doubled neck axis by at most max(2px,5% width). Never shrink or consult image center/other candidates.
small_scene: Semantic fallback with at least one eligible bottle, every eligible bottle height <=20% image long side.
tracker: Only the nearest two eligible bottle centers within 5px of equal distance: detector-mask seed at y-quantiles .1,.5,.9; RGB ROI plus20% long-side context. Filter masks for IoU>=.5 and <=max(4px,10% short side) per-edge displacement before choosing highest model score. Preserve original RGB rectangle for crop.
central: One fixed centered 160px PNG crop, with English wine bottle / bottle / bottle held in hand nouns. Reject detections lacking max(2px,5% crop side) context at an interior crop edge. Project complete masks back to original coordinates.
budget: At most two localizations plus one central scan, shared monotonic deadline. Optional failures/exhaustion preserve valid primary output. Supplied detections never start inference.
